WEEK 14 — OPERATIONS LOG
Author: Officer Verlaine

DAY 92:
Nominal. Crew rotation completed. Kowalski flagged vent replacement in C-Deck for third consecutive week. Approved.

DAY 93:
MUTHUR flagged minor LS temperature drop in B3 (22C to 19C over 6 hours). Self-corrected. No action taken.

DAY 94:
Chen raised concerns about sounds from C3 during night cycle. Could not reproduce. Logged as acoustical artefact.

DAY 95:
W-Y check-in. Routine. No new instructions regarding XB-71.

DAY 96:
Kowalski completed vent C3-North replacement. Fourth unit this month. Cause undetermined.

DAY 97:
Crew morale acceptable. Rest cycle observed.

DAY 98:
[ENTRY MISSING]
